items.title: Solar costs for business to be slashed under energy scheme expansion
items.description: The federal government is set to announce changes to the Small-scale Renewable Energy scheme in a bid to help businesses install solar systems and close the gap with residential take-up.

items.title: Tony Burke delays speech expected to reveal sweeping migration cuts
items.description: The ABC understands the cuts to migration numbers are contentious within Labor, but no reason for the delay is given.

items.title: Labor unveils 'widow tax' fix after negative gearing backlash
items.description: The government is also consulting on carve-outs and changes covering newly built homes, affordable and disability housing and its new capital gains tax system.

items.title: 'Script hasn't changed': Kevin Rudd derides Hanson's leadership capability
items.description: Former prime minister Kevin Rudd says One Nation leader Pauline Hanson has no real answers for the issues facing Australians but he does believe AUKUS submarines are a good thing for the nation.

items.title: 'Our only option': Aboriginal police officers take racism allegations to court
items.description: Current and former Aboriginal community police officers have launched a class action alleging they were racially vilified, abused and underpaid while working for the NT Police Force.

items.title: Sportsbet, TAB deny allegations reps offered escort and drugs to gambler
items.description: Sportsbet and TAB have denied explosive claims they offered a young gambler access to illicit drugs and escorts as part of an inducement program.

items.title: US vow to dismantle the International Criminal Court labelled 'very worrying'
items.description: The Trump administration has vowed to dismantle the International Criminal Court "brick by brick", but analysts warn it's a move that has more to do with local politics than genuine concerns about the system.

items.title: Questions about Sydney protest spark tense exchange at royal commission
items.description: The head of a peak Jewish body has criticised the conduct of protesters at a pro-Palestinian rally in the wake of Hamas's attack on Israel, prompting a tense exchange at the antisemitism royal commission.

items.title: Alan Jones told 17yo 'there are no rules' at his home, court hears
items.description: A man accusing Alan Jones of indecently assaulting him has detailed in court a night at the broadcaster's farm, where he said Mr Jones demanded he have a shower and come out wearing "a robe and nothing else".

items.title: Billion-dollar property collapse highlights private credit danger
items.description: Examinations of the downfall of Jon Adgemis's property empire may well shed light on the extent to which private credit firms, essentially a shadow banking industry with little or no regulation, have their hooks into the economy.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
